definition.name: Accordion
definition.description: A labelled group of native disclosure sections.

documentation.usage: Add independently expandable Accordion Item entries to the Items slot.
documentation.accessibility: Native details and summary remain keyboard operable without JavaScript.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: The shared runtime preserves the documented keyboard interaction.
checks.remediation: Retain the canonical module and its tested keyboard contract.

checks.summary: All authored content remains available when enhancement is unavailable.
checks.remediation: Keep the server-rendered native fallback in logical source order.

definition.name: Accordion Item
definition.description: One native disclosure section inside an Accordion.

documentation.usage: Add one independently expandable section.
documentation.accessibility: Write a specific summary that identifies the hidden content.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Audio
definition.description: A native audio player with an accessible title and transcript link.

documentation.usage: Use for a site-hosted or HTTPS recording with native playback controls.
documentation.accessibility: Provide a specific title and a transcript for spoken information.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Spoken audio needs an equivalent transcript when required.
checks.remediation: Link a complete transcript and describe important non-speech audio.

definition.name: Badge
definition.description: A short status or category label using approved semantic variants.

documentation.usage: Use for short metadata or status, not as the only explanation of a state.
documentation.accessibility: The text, not colour, communicates the badge meaning.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Breadcrumb
definition.description: An ordered navigation trail for the current page hierarchy.

fields.label: Links
fields.description: Ordered links from the broadest page to the current page.

documentation.usage: Place near the page start and order links from broadest to current context.
documentation.accessibility: Use a distinct navigation label and identify the current page with aria-current.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Breadcrumb links use native anchor navigation and visible focus.
checks.remediation: Name every hierarchy level and mark the current destination in its link attributes.

definition.name: Button
definition.description: A call to action rendered as a button or link.

documentation.usage: Use for an action or prominent navigation destination.
documentation.accessibility: Use a specific label that describes the result of activating the control.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: The rendered action needs an adequate touch target.
checks.remediation: Verify the final design provides sufficient target size and spacing.

checks.summary: Text, focus and disabled states require sufficient contrast.
checks.remediation: Review the final token combination in every supported theme and state.

definition.name: CAPTCHA
definition.description: A provider-neutral form verification boundary.

documentation.usage: Use only when the platform CAPTCHA capability and an approved adapter are healthy.
documentation.accessibility: Provide an alternate verification path and never claim availability while provider verification is unconfigured.

checks.summary: Provider content requires both an accessible title and fallback text.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title and a useful alternative when provider content cannot load.

limitations: Requires capability "forms.captcha" to report healthy.
Requires provider adapter "captcha.hcaptcha" to report healthy.
The manifest records the provider boundary; it does not claim that external provider output rendered.

definition.name: Card
definition.description: A contained summary with optional media and action.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: Ordered links or native buttons rendered by this component.

documentation.usage: Summarise one destination or record. Use Card Grid for repeated cards.
documentation.accessibility: Use a specific title and avoid duplicating competing links to the same destination.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Card Grid
definition.description: A responsive collection composed from the shared Card definition.

documentation.usage: Use for a short manual collection of comparable destinations.
documentation.accessibility: Keep card headings and action labels specific; document order remains the reading order.

definition.name: Carousel
definition.description: A controlled sequence of governed content slides.

slots.name: Slides
slots.description: Ordered components presented as carousel slides.

documentation.usage: Use sparingly when related content benefits from sequential presentation.
documentation.accessibility: Prefer manual controls. Autoplay pauses on focus or pointer interaction and is disabled for reduced-motion users.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Previous, next and arrow-key controls move through slides.
checks.remediation: Run the carousel runtime keyboard behavior suite after implementation changes.

checks.summary: User-initiated slide changes announce the current position.
checks.remediation: Keep the polite status region and meaningful carousel label.

checks.summary: Autoplay pauses for interaction and is disabled for reduced motion.
checks.remediation: Do not bypass the runtime reduced-motion and pause checks.

checks.summary: All slides remain visible in document order without JavaScript.
checks.remediation: Only hide inactive slides after progressive enhancement.

definition.name: Checkbox
definition.description: A form control for an independent yes/no choice.

documentation.usage: Use for a choice that can be selected independently.
documentation.accessibility: Pair with a visible label describing the selected state.

checks.summary: This form control has no visible associated label.
checks.remediation: Add a visible Label immediately before the control or explicitly target its field ID.

checks.summary: Form field IDs must be present and unique within the page.
checks.remediation: Assign a stable field ID that is not used by another control.

definition.name: Checkbox Group
definition.description: A fieldset of independently selectable Checkbox controls.

documentation.usage: Use when zero or more answers may be selected.
documentation.accessibility: The fieldset legend states the shared question; every option keeps its own label.

definition.name: Code / Preformatted Text
definition.description: Whitespace-preserving text with safe language metadata.

documentation.usage: Use for source code, command output or any content where whitespace is meaningful.
documentation.accessibility: Name the example and enable wrapping when horizontal scrolling would make it difficult to read.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Comparison Table
definition.description: A captioned table comparing any set of options or features.

documentation.usage: Use for genuine row-and-column comparison, including but not limited to pricing.
documentation.accessibility: Provide a specific caption and preserve row and column header associations.

definition.name: Container
definition.description: A neutral content container with a controlled semantic element.

fields.label: Semantic element
fields.description: The HTML element that describes the text meaning; visual typography belongs to classes.

documentation.usage: Group content when no more specific catalogue entry applies.
documentation.accessibility: Choose a semantic element only when it matches the content purpose.

definition.name: Date Input
definition.description: A calendar date.

documentation.usage: Use Date Input when the submitted value is a calendar date.
documentation.accessibility: Pair the input with a visible Label and useful autocomplete value.

checks.summary: This form control has no visible associated label.
checks.remediation: Add a visible Label immediately before the control or explicitly target its field ID.

checks.summary: Form field IDs must be present and unique within the page.
checks.remediation: Assign a stable field ID that is not used by another control.

definition.name: Delete Draft
definition.description: Delete the current persistent recovery record.

documentation.usage: Offer a direct privacy control beside Save Draft.
documentation.accessibility: Use an explicit label and announce successful deletion or revision conflicts.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

limitations: Requires capability "forms.drafts" to report healthy.

definition.name: Modal / Dialog
definition.description: Focused interactive content with governed dismissal and focus.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: Governed content shown inside the overlay.

documentation.usage: Use when a short task or decision must interrupt the page flow.
documentation.accessibility: The enhanced overlay traps focus, restores the trigger and supports Escape; without JavaScript it remains a details disclosure.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Overlay triggers, dismissal and Tab order follow the documented keyboard contract.
checks.remediation: Run the overlay runtime keyboard behavior suite after implementation changes.

checks.summary: Focus enters, stays within and returns from the enhanced overlay.
checks.remediation: Keep a visible close action and do not remove the runtime focus boundary.

checks.summary: Overlay content remains available as a native details disclosure.
checks.remediation: Keep the summary and inline panel usable before enhancement.

definition.name: Download
definition.description: A described link to a downloadable site asset.

documentation.usage: Describe the file and its purpose before the download link.
documentation.accessibility: Include file type and size in the description when that affects the decision to download.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Drawer
definition.description: Supporting content presented from a governed viewport edge.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: Governed content shown inside the overlay.

documentation.usage: Use for supporting navigation or detail that can be dismissed without losing page context.
documentation.accessibility: The enhanced drawer shares the dialog focus and dismissal contract and remains an inline disclosure without JavaScript.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Overlay triggers, dismissal and Tab order follow the documented keyboard contract.
checks.remediation: Run the overlay runtime keyboard behavior suite after implementation changes.

checks.summary: Focus enters, stays within and returns from the enhanced overlay.
checks.remediation: Keep a visible close action and do not remove the runtime focus boundary.

checks.summary: Overlay content remains available as a native details disclosure.
checks.remediation: Keep the summary and inline panel usable before enhancement.

definition.name: Email Input
definition.description: An email address.

documentation.usage: Use Email Input when the submitted value is an email address.
documentation.accessibility: Pair the input with a visible Label and useful autocomplete value.

checks.summary: This form control has no visible associated label.
checks.remediation: Add a visible Label immediately before the control or explicitly target its field ID.

checks.summary: Form field IDs must be present and unique within the page.
checks.remediation: Assign a stable field ID that is not used by another control.

definition.name: Embed
definition.description: A consent-delayed third-party embed resolved through an approved adapter.

documentation.usage: Enable the provider-embed capability and select an allow-listed adapter before insertion.
documentation.accessibility: Keep consent activation keyboard reachable and provide equivalent fallback content.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Provider content requires both an accessible title and fallback text.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title and a useful alternative when provider content cannot load.

limitations: Requires capability "embeds.provider" to report healthy.

definition.name: Empty State
definition.description: Explains an empty collection or unavailable result with a next action.

documentation.usage: Explain why content is absent and offer the most useful next action.
documentation.accessibility: Do not rely on illustration alone; keep the message and next action explicit.

definition.name: FAQ List
definition.description: Frequently asked questions composed from native Accordion items.

documentation.usage: Use for genuinely frequent questions; keep answers useful when read directly.
documentation.accessibility: Uses native details and summary controls and remains operable without JavaScript.

definition.name: File Attachment
definition.description: A private, malware-scanned file upload for CMS-native forms.

documentation.usage: Bind to an Attachment data field. Files remain private, quarantined and unclaimable until the configured malware scanner returns clean.
documentation.accessibility: Provide a visible label, accepted-file guidance and a non-colour-only failure message.

checks.summary: Upload progress, scan failures and retry state must be announced.
checks.remediation: Verify aggregate and per-file progress remain available to assistive technology.

limitations: Requires capability "forms.attachments" to report healthy.

definition.name: Form Accordion
definition.description: Form-aware sections composed from native Accordion items.

documentation.usage: Use only when collapsing long form sections materially helps authors.
documentation.accessibility: Native details remain available without JavaScript and validation reveals errors.

checks.summary: Validation reveals a closed section before focusing its first invalid field.
checks.remediation: Keep each native summary specific and preserve validation-to-focus behavior.

definition.name: Form Actions
definition.description: A governed layout boundary for submit and secondary actions.

documentation.usage: Group the primary submit control and any secondary link at the end of a form.
documentation.accessibility: Keep the primary action clear and preserve a predictable keyboard order.

definition.name: Form Container
definition.description: A CMS-native or custom form boundary.

documentation.usage: Add approved fields and actions inside this form boundary.
documentation.accessibility: Provide labels, instructions, errors and a clear submission result.

checks.summary: Submission success and errors require appropriate live announcements.
checks.remediation: Run the CMS form runtime announcement behavior tests.

checks.summary: Invalid submissions must reveal and focus the first invalid field.
checks.remediation: Run validation through nested disclosure fixtures and verify focus placement.

definition.name: Form Embed
definition.description: An approved internal or provider form embedded behind consent and sandbox policy.

documentation.usage: Enable the form-embed capability and choose one governed height mode and provider adapter.
documentation.accessibility: Name the embedded form, preserve focus order and provide a direct accessible fallback.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Provider content requires both an accessible title and fallback text.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title and a useful alternative when provider content cannot load.

limitations: Requires capability "forms.embed" to report healthy.

definition.name: Field Error
definition.description: A validation message associated with one form control.

documentation.usage: Place beside the control whose server validation error it reports.
documentation.accessibility: The runtime marks the control invalid, announces the message and focuses the first invalid field.

checks.summary: Field errors must be announced and associated with the invalid control.
checks.remediation: Verify aria-invalid, aria-errormessage, announcement and first-invalid focus behavior.

definition.name: Form Field Group
definition.description: A governed layout boundary for one field, its label, help and error.

documentation.usage: Group one control with its visible label, help and field error.
documentation.accessibility: Keep the label and any described help or error in the same group as the control.

definition.name: Field Help
definition.description: Persistent instructions associated with one form control.

documentation.usage: Add concise instructions that remain visible before and after validation.
documentation.accessibility: The form runtime associates this text through aria-describedby.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Field help must be connected through the control description.
checks.remediation: Verify aria-describedby includes the authored help message.

definition.name: Label
definition.description: A visible label for a form control.

documentation.usage: Place immediately before the control it describes.
documentation.accessibility: Use visible, specific labels; placeholders do not replace labels.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Form Status
definition.description: A submission status or result message for a form.

documentation.usage: Explain form status or the result of a submission.
documentation.accessibility: Status messages must be concise and announced without moving focus unnecessarily.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Submission status changes must be announced without unnecessary focus movement.
checks.remediation: Run the form runtime announcement and focus behavior tests.

definition.name: Panel
definition.description: A titled semantic group for related form content.

documentation.usage: Group fields that share one purpose under a concise title.
documentation.accessibility: Keep a logical source order and identify the section with its heading.

definition.name: Form Step
definition.description: A recoverable, progressively enhanced wizard step.

documentation.usage: Place fields and actions inside ordered steps. Without JavaScript every step remains visible.
documentation.accessibility: Give every step a useful title and preserve logical source order.

definition.name: Summary / Review
definition.description: A review step with editable summary content and final actions.

documentation.usage: Summarise entered values before the final submission action.
documentation.accessibility: Keep edit actions specific and retain semantic headings for grouped answers.

definition.name: Form Tabs
definition.description: Form-aware sections using the shared Tabs keyboard and fallback contract.

documentation.usage: Use one Form Tabs pattern and configure horizontal or vertical orientation in HTML view.
documentation.accessibility: Labels, keyboard behavior and progressive fallback come from shared Tabs.

checks.summary: Tabs provide arrow-key navigation and every panel stays visible without JavaScript.
checks.remediation: Use the orientation variant and preserve the shared Tabs runtime.

checks.summary: Validation activates a hidden panel before focusing its first invalid field.
checks.remediation: Keep validation state connected to the shared Tabs activation contract.

definition.name: Gallery
definition.description: An ordered responsive collection of governed images.

documentation.usage: Use for related images whose order and captions carry meaning.
documentation.accessibility: Review every image alternative and preserve a meaningful document order.

checks.summary: Every gallery image needs contextual alternative treatment.
checks.remediation: Review each Media Library alternative before publication.

definition.name: Columns / Grid
definition.description: A responsive two-column authored layout.

documentation.usage: Place governed content inside each declared column region.
documentation.accessibility: Keep reading order meaningful when columns stack on narrow screens.

definition.name: Heading
definition.description: A section heading using the shared text implementation.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The literal authored text. Markup is escaped and hard newlines publish as line breaks.

fields.label: Semantic element
fields.description: The HTML element that describes the text meaning; visual typography belongs to classes.

documentation.usage: Introduce a page or section with a meaningful heading.
documentation.accessibility: Keep heading levels logical and do not choose a level for visual size alone.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Heading levels should not skip a level in page order.
checks.remediation: Choose the next logical heading level based on document structure.

definition.name: Hero
definition.description: A major page introduction with optional media and actions.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: Ordered links or native buttons rendered by this component.

documentation.usage: Use once near the start of a landing page.
documentation.accessibility: Keep the heading concise and ensure optional media has suitable alternative text.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific heading value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: The Hero heading must fit the page heading hierarchy.
checks.remediation: Use one page-level H1 and keep subsequent heading levels logical.

definition.name: Hidden Field
definition.description: A fixed or context-derived value submitted without a visible control.

documentation.usage: Use only for non-secret fixed metadata that the server will validate independently.
documentation.accessibility: Hidden fields have no visual or assistive-technology interface and must not carry instructions.

definition.name: Icon
definition.description: An approved symbolic icon with controlled semantics and size.

documentation.usage: Use only an approved symbol and pair unfamiliar icons with visible text.
documentation.accessibility: Decorative icons are hidden; meaningful icons require a concise label.

checks.summary: Meaningful icons expose text and decorative icons stay silent.
checks.remediation: Supply a short label whenever the icon communicates meaning.

definition.name: Icon List
definition.description: A concise repeated list ready for approved icon decoration.

documentation.usage: Use the shared semantic List; apply approved decorative icons through the design system.
documentation.accessibility: Keep the textual item meaningful without relying on the decorative icon.

definition.name: Image
definition.description: An image selected from the Media Library.

documentation.usage: Use an uploaded asset with loading behavior appropriate to its page position.
documentation.accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text in the Media Library or mark decorative images.

checks.summary: Image alternative text must match the authored context.
checks.remediation: Review the Media Library alternative text and mark decorative images appropriately.

definition.name: Language Navigation
definition.description: A locale switcher supplied by the configured localisation capability.

documentation.usage: Enable and configure localisation before adding the approved locale-link item renderer.
documentation.accessibility: Use each language’s own name and identify the current locale without relying on colour.

checks.summary: The locale navigation and current language require clear programmatic names.
checks.remediation: Name the navigation and expose the current locale on its selected link.

limitations: Requires capability "localization.locales" to report healthy.

definition.name: Link
definition.description: An inline or grouped navigation link.

documentation.usage: Use for navigation within text or a group of linked content.
documentation.accessibility: Link text must make sense without relying on surrounding prose.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific text value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: List
definition.description: A static or generated collection using one governed item template.

documentation.usage: Choose manual items or a registered loop source and author one governed item template.
documentation.accessibility: Retain meaningful item semantics, source order and the shared collection status.

definition.name: Logo Cloud
definition.description: A governed group of partner or organisation logos.

documentation.usage: Use for a curated set of organisations with consistent image treatment.
documentation.accessibility: Give linked logos an organisation name and mark purely decorative logos appropriately.

definition.name: Map
definition.description: A consent-delayed OpenStreetMap embed.

documentation.usage: Paste an OpenStreetMap export URL from the approved provider origin.
documentation.accessibility: Use a title that identifies the location and provide the address in ordinary page text.

checks.summary: Provider content requires both an accessible title and fallback text.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title and a useful alternative when provider content cannot load.

limitations: Requires provider adapter "maps.openstreetmap" to report healthy.
The manifest records the provider boundary; it does not claim that external provider output rendered.

definition.name: Media
definition.description: Accessible hosted audio or video using one governed display definition.

documentation.usage: Choose Audio or Hosted video; provider video remains behind its approved adapter entry.
documentation.accessibility: Provide captions for video and a transcript for spoken audio where required.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

checks.summary: Autoplay and motion require available controls and reduced-motion review.
checks.remediation: Keep controls enabled and avoid autoplay unless the policy permits it.

definition.name: Navigation
definition.description: A labelled navigation region with governed link content.

fields.label: Navigation items
fields.description: Ordered links rendered as one semantic navigation list.

documentation.usage: Use a distinct label when more than one navigation region appears on the page.
documentation.accessibility: Keep link text descriptive and identify the current page where applicable.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Next Step
definition.description: Move to the next authored form step.

documentation.usage: Advance in source order; all steps remain available when JavaScript is absent.
documentation.accessibility: Move focus into the newly revealed step.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific label value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Notice / Callout
definition.description: Highlights important information with an approved semantic type.

fields.description: Ordered links or native buttons rendered by this component.

documentation.usage: Use for information that should stand apart from the surrounding flow.
documentation.accessibility: Do not rely on colour alone to communicate the notice type.

checks.summary: This component requires a non-empty accessible name.
checks.remediation: Provide a specific title value that explains the component's purpose.

definition.name: Number Input
definition.description: A numeric value.

documentation.usage: Use Number Input when the submitted value is a numeric value.
documentation.accessibility: Pair the input with a visible Label and useful autocomplete value.

checks.summary: This form control has no visible associated label.
checks.remediation: Add a visible Label immediately before the control or explicitly target its field ID.

checks.summary: Form field IDs must be present and unique within the page.
checks.remediation: Assign a stable field ID that is not used by another control.

definition.name: Option
definition.description: One selectable value inside a Select.

documentation.usage: Add one author-facing choice to a Select.
documentation.accessibility: Use a distinct label that communicates the choice.

definition.name: Option Group
definition.description: A labelled group of related Select options.

documentation.usage: Group a longer option list into meaningful labelled sections.
documentation.accessibility: Use a short group label that distinguishes its options.
